_comment: Append one entry per published article. next_brief.py reads this to avoid repeats and to space out cities and topics, and the writer reads the last ten titles and opening patterns to avoid writing the same post twice.

posts.title: The Google Business Profile settings most Bengaluru businesses never touch
posts.opening_pattern: direct instruction to the reader — go open your profile right now

posts.title: How to get quoted by ChatGPT, starting with the robots.txt line you missed
posts.opening_pattern: statistic about India's weekly ChatGPT user base, then a blunt claim that the reader is missing from those answers

posts.title: Stop asking your agency why the numbers went up. Ask what they can't see
posts.primary_keyword: digital marketing agency not delivering results
posts.opening_pattern: scene from a monthly review call, 41 slides and a question nobody could answer

posts.title: Your Google Ads aren't converting, and five of the six reasons are settings
posts.opening_pattern: flat opinion correcting the reader's diagnosis, the ads are fine and a setting is not

posts.title: Google doesn't penalize AI content. It penalizes everyone writing the same article
posts.opening_pattern: observation of the SERP itself, the same article found nine times over

posts.title: How to choose a digital marketing agency by planning for the day it ends
posts.primary_keyword: how to choose a digital marketing agency
posts.opening_pattern: opens at the end of the relationship rather than the start, with the tenure numbers

posts.title: Estonia builds the better product and keeps losing to the better distributed one
posts.opening_pattern: concession opening, genuine praise for the engineering culture before the turn

posts.title: Run your own SEO audit in two hours before you pay four figures for one
posts.primary_keyword: how to do an seo audit yourself
posts.opening_pattern: what a paid audit actually contains, a crawler export with a logo on the cover

posts.title: Impressions only ever go up. That's exactly why they're still in your report
posts.opening_pattern: leads with the structural property that unites vanity metrics, they only move one direction

posts.title: Every local SEO guide tells clinics to ask for reviews. Indian doctors cannot
posts.opening_pattern: the patient's actual behaviour at 9pm, tracing the ninety second discovery journey

posts.title: What digital marketing actually costs in India, and why the quotes vary tenfold
posts.opening_pattern: two honest quotes for the same brief ten times apart, and what actually differs

posts.title: Cold email deliverability is a DNS problem before it's a copywriting problem
posts.opening_pattern: the timeline of a domain burning out, week one to week five

posts.title: Most traffic drops are not algorithm updates. Rewriting in week one makes it worse
posts.opening_pattern: the shape of the graph itself, cliff versus step versus slope, as the first diagnostic

posts.title: WhatsApp stops being free in October. Three things to fix before then
posts.opening_pattern: the same enquiry sent two ways, and the gap between the reply times

posts.title: Is Google Ads worth it in a market as small as Estonia?
posts.primary_keyword: is google ads worth it in a small market
posts.opening_pattern: answers the title question in the first line, then justifies it

posts.title: How much does a digital marketing agency cost?
posts.primary_keyword: how much does a digital marketing agency cost
posts.opening_pattern: the price range as the bare first line, before any framing

posts.title: How do I redesign my website without losing my Google traffic?
posts.opening_pattern: the project is misfiled as design when it is actually a migration

posts.title: How do I start selling online in India?
posts.primary_keyword: how to sell online in india
posts.opening_pattern: the single fork that determines everything else, stated before any steps

posts.title: Best digital marketing agencies in 2026, and how to pick one that fits
posts.opening_pattern: explains how these listicles are actually assembled before giving one

posts.title: How do I get more customers online without spending more on ads?
posts.primary_keyword: how to get more customers online
posts.opening_pattern: reframes the question from more traffic to more of the traffic already arriving

posts.title: Is SEO worth it for a small business in 2026?
posts.primary_keyword: is seo worth it for small business
posts.opening_pattern: splits the question into two that have opposite answers

posts.title: How do Estonian companies sell into Finland and Sweden?
posts.primary_keyword: how to sell to nordic customers from estonia
posts.opening_pattern: the tactic that reads as competence at home and as pressure there

posts.title: Is Google Ads worth it for a small business?
posts.primary_keyword: is google ads worth it for small business
posts.opening_pattern: hands the reader the deciding formula before any argument

posts.title: How do I get more Google reviews for my business?
posts.primary_keyword: how do i get more google reviews
posts.opening_pattern: the common practice that quietly became a legal liability

posts.title: Do I need a website if my business is already on Instagram?
posts.primary_keyword: do i need a website if i have instagram
posts.opening_pattern: stress test, what would remain if the account vanished tonight

posts.title: What schema markup does a local business actually need?
posts.opening_pattern: corrects the core misconception about what schema does before any code

posts.title: How do I handle price objections without discounting?
posts.opening_pattern: what the discount teaches the buyer, stated as an irreversible cost

posts.title: Google Ads vs Meta Ads: which is better for my business?
posts.primary_keyword: google ads vs facebook ads which is better
posts.opening_pattern: asks one question about the reader's own product, since the product not the platforms decides it

posts.title: Does Estonia's 0% corporate tax change how I should budget marketing?
posts.opening_pattern: starts from the tax rise that was legislated then cancelled, and asks where the money budgeted for it went

posts.title: What should a content brief include? A template you can copy
posts.opening_pattern: quotes the three line brief most teams actually send, then points at what is already wrong in it

posts.title: Should I hire a marketing agency, a freelancer, or someone in house?
posts.primary_keyword: should i hire a marketing agency or a freelancer
posts.opening_pattern: skips month one where all three look identical and goes to the month each arrangement predictably breaks

posts.title: How much should a small business spend on digital marketing in India?
posts.primary_keyword: how much should a small business spend on digital marketing
posts.opening_pattern: gives the floor below which the spend is wasted before giving any target range

posts.title: Why aren't my leads converting into sales?
posts.opening_pattern: sends the reader to read the last fifty rejected leads, then argues the dispute was engineered by the comp plan

posts.title: What is Performance Max actually doing with my budget?
posts.opening_pattern: opens the channel report that did not exist a year ago and reads the budget split straight off it

posts.title: Why is my traffic down when my rankings haven't changed?
posts.opening_pattern: starts from the meeting where the true explanation for the drop sounds exactly like an excuse

posts.title: What payment methods do Estonian shoppers actually use?
posts.opening_pattern: describes the payment flow the local buyer expects, then what a card only checkout puts in front of them instead

posts.title: What should I expect in the first 90 days with a marketing consultant?
posts.primary_keyword: what to expect in the first 90 days with a marketing consultant
posts.opening_pattern: opens on the red flag that reads as competence, a finished plan arriving in week one

posts.title: How do I respond to a negative Google review?
posts.primary_keyword: how to respond to negative google reviews
posts.opening_pattern: puts two replies to the same one star review side by side and asks which business the reader would call

posts.title: Why is my customer acquisition cost rising on Meta ads?
posts.opening_pattern: reframes CPM as a market price the reader does not set, so the usual levers aim at the wrong variable

posts.title: How do I build an internal linking strategy?
posts.opening_pattern: asks which page collects the most internal links, since the honest answer exposes the misallocation

posts.title: Are Angi leads worth it for a home services business?
posts.opening_pattern: a scene with a timestamp, the request landing on several phones at once, so what was bought was an entry not a customer

posts.title: How do I get my restaurant found on Google, not just Zomato?
posts.opening_pattern: lists the searches the aggregator apps never see, where the demand already sits commission free

posts.title: How do I sell SaaS to US customers from Europe?
posts.primary_keyword: selling saas to us customers from europe
posts.opening_pattern: opens by inverting this site's own Nordic advice, since the register that gets believed there reads as no conviction in the US

posts.title: How do Google Local Services Ads work, and are they worth it?
posts.opening_pattern: walks down what the searcher's phone screen shows in order, then asks where the reader's budget sits in that stack

posts.title: Should I refresh old blog posts or write new ones?
posts.primary_keyword: content decay refresh old blog posts
posts.opening_pattern: opens on deletion, the best refresh program starting by removing a third of the blog, then calls most refresh work cosmetic

posts.title: Why are my GA4 conversions not tracking?
posts.opening_pattern: tells the reader to stop and send themselves a real lead from mobile data, then explains why both conditions of the test matter

posts.title: Do AI SDR tools actually work?
posts.opening_pattern: explains personalisation as a costly signal, so the cost going to zero is what emptied it of meaning

posts.title: Is SMS marketing legal, and what consent do I actually need?
posts.opening_pattern: multiplies the per message statutory damages across one ordinary send to state the exposure before any advice

posts.title: Should I do SEO or Google Ads first?
posts.primary_keyword: seo vs google ads which is better
posts.opening_pattern: makes the reader answer a cash runway question first, since liquidity decides this rather than any property of either channel
posts._note: brief b-014 was retargeted from its primary keyword, which duplicated the published is-seo-worth-it-for-small-business, onto its secondary keyword

posts.title: How do I make my e-Residency company look legitimate?
posts.opening_pattern: names the asymmetry, that an efficient remote company and a shell company give off identical signals from outside

posts.title: My competitor is buying fake reviews. What can I do?
posts.opening_pattern: reads the tell off the competitor's profile, the volume and the timestamps, before turning to what can be done
posts._note: brief b-069's own angle was already covered by how-to-get-more-google-reviews, so this answers the competitor question instead

posts.title: How much should I spend on Google Ads to make it work?
posts.opening_pattern: states the two budgets that produce identical outcomes, one of which the reader is paying for
posts._note: brief b-066 asked for the backwards LTV calculation, which is the published India budget post and the US max affordable click post; written as the floor calculation instead, and framed as the pair to the ceiling

posts.title: How fast do I need to follow up on a B2B lead?
posts.opening_pattern: reframes the diagnosis, that this is lead decay rather than lead generation, since latency is the only variable that changed

posts.title: Can I use Google Analytics and the Meta pixel on a medical website?
posts.opening_pattern: describes exactly what leaves the browser on a condition page, field by field, before any argument about whether it is allowed

posts.title: Should I block AI crawlers like GPTBot?
posts.opening_pattern: states the exchange rate first, pages taken per visitor returned, so the decision reads as pricing rather than principle

posts.title: Why is my landing page not converting?
posts.opening_pattern: runs the page load as a second by second sequence on a mid range phone, so the reader watches the click they paid for expire

posts.title: Does being an Estonian company help you sell?
posts.opening_pattern: hands the reader a swap test on their own headline, since a line that survives a competitor's name distinguishes nothing

posts.title: How do I do SEO for multiple locations?
posts.opening_pattern: sends the reader to interview the one branch that already ranks, on the basis that the difference will turn out to be a person rather than a technical setting

posts.title: Does Reddit marketing work for a business?
posts.opening_pattern: stages the removal from the moderator's side of the screen, the four things they check in thirty seconds, before any argument about whether the channel is worth it
posts._note: Brief framed Reddit as the most quoted site on the internet. Kept the citation share but added the volatility counter-argument (ChatGPT Reddit citations 3.83% to 0.52% in four days, March 2026 core update), since that is the honest 2026 picture.

posts.title: What should a B2B founder in India post on LinkedIn?
posts.opening_pattern: sets two results from the same week side by side, the 40,000 impression post that produced nothing against the eleven like comment that produced a customer

posts.title: Who should control franchise marketing, corporate or the franchisee?
posts.opening_pattern: quotes the two complaints verbatim, one from each chair in the same meeting, and concedes both are accurate before blaming the structure that produces them

posts.title: What should be on your Shopify SEO checklist?
posts.opening_pattern: absolves the reader first, the duplicate URLs are generated by the platform rather than by any mistake they made, then does the arithmetic on how many that comes to

posts.title: How should I split a Rs 50,000 marketing budget in India?
posts.primary_keyword: how to split a marketing budget india
posts.opening_pattern: reads the owner's actual monthly line items back to them one by one, six defensible items adding to nothing, before any argument about allocation
posts._note: Retargeted. The brief's primary keyword, marketing budget for small business india, is already published as digital-marketing-budget-small-business-india (4 Sep), and its secondary keyword is that post's slug. Wrote the uncovered allocation question from the brief's own angle instead.

posts.title: How do I answer a vendor security questionnaire?
posts.opening_pattern: names the person who actually decides, someone in risk who has never seen the product and never will, before any advice about the document itself
posts._note: Retargeted. b-078 duplicated how-to-sell-to-nordic-customers-from-estonia (30 Aug) on every bullet including GDPR cold email, LinkedIn, localised proof and euro versus krona pricing. Wrote the uncovered half instead: the vendor security review that now stalls these deals, under DORA and NIS2 supplier flowdown.

posts.title: HubSpot vs Salesforce: which should a small business pick?
posts.primary_keyword: hubspot vs salesforce for small business
posts.opening_pattern: asks the reader to name the specific person who will be in the settings screen on an ordinary Tuesday, and says the rest of the comparison is void until they can

posts.title: Yelp or Google Business Profile: which should I fix first?
posts.opening_pattern: puts the same action on both platforms, asking a happy customer for a review, and shows it is correct on one and punishable on the other

posts.title: Is quick commerce killing D2C brands in India?
posts.opening_pattern: locates the change precisely, not the customer moving but the ten second window in which the decision now happens, and describes what is visible inside it
posts._note: Brief's primary keyword was the broad 'd2c marketing india'. Wrote to the secondary, quick commerce vs own website, since the marketplace-or-own-site decision is already published as how-to-sell-online-in-india.

posts.title: Why don't my GA4 and Google Ads numbers match?
posts.opening_pattern: states in one sentence each what the two reports are actually answering, so the reader sees two different questions rather than one number reported twice

posts.title: Why isn't my B2B demand generation producing pipeline?
posts.opening_pattern: names the single test every activity is judged by, then shows one whole half of the job cannot pass it by construction rather than by failing

posts.title: How do I get backlinks for an Indian business?
posts.opening_pattern: opens on the link selling pitch that arrives on WhatsApp, quotes its price, and reprices it as an asset with a two month half life

posts.title: What should a small Estonian startup copy from the unicorns?
posts.opening_pattern: dates the tactic being copied, places it in that company's seventh year against the reader's second, and reframes it as the victory lap rather than the climb

posts.title: Which Klaviyo flows actually make money?
posts.primary_keyword: klaviyo email flows that make money
posts.opening_pattern: puts send volume against revenue share, five percent of sends earning forty percent of the money, so the reader sees their weekly effort sitting in the minority half

posts.title: Should I remove the book a demo button?
posts.primary_keyword: book a demo vs self serve
posts.opening_pattern: opens on the paradox in the data, that publishing pricing lowers the demo request rate while raising the rate at which those requests become pipeline, and treats the drop as the point

posts.title: How do real estate agents in Bengaluru get their own leads?
posts.primary_keyword: local seo for real estate agents india
posts.opening_pattern: stages the shared portal lead from the buyer's side, one enquiry and nine phones ringing inside the hour, so the agent sees what they actually bought
posts._note: Fourth India local SEO by vertical. Kept off the template by anchoring it in portal lead economics and the fact that nobody searches for an agent, so the map pack advice in the clinic and restaurant posts does not transfer. Says so explicitly in the piece.

posts.title: Does a Los Angeles business need a Los Angeles agency?
posts.primary_keyword: remote marketing consultant vs local agency los angeles
posts.opening_pattern: dismantles the word local using the county's own geography, twelve miles and fifty minutes of freeway across 88 incorporated cities, so proximity stops being a market claim
posts._note: Corrected the brief on its Spanish-language premise. The brief assumed English-only campaigns leave money on the table; census estimates put roughly 85% of LA County's Spanish-at-home speakers as speaking English very well, so the real requirement is cultural register in creative rather than translation. Wrote it that way and said so in the piece. Chosen as the single post covering this question; b-108, b-109 and b-117 retired as a competing series.

posts.title: Which state privacy laws apply to my business?
posts.opening_pattern: opens on the exemption the reader believes they have, being under the revenue threshold, and names the two states where no such threshold exists
